films.line_mk: Од празен простор до совршен дом.
films.line_en: From empty space to a perfect home.
films.desc_en: A seamless timelapse morph showcasing the transformation of a barren plot in Skopje into a premium residential complex.
films.music: slow cinematic ambient building up to grand orchestral swell, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Темелите на вашата иднина почнуваат овде.

shots.kf: Wide angle landscape shot of an empty construction plot in Skopje, Mount Vodno in the background. Early morning golden hour light, misty atmosphere. Earth and gravel textures, warm earthy color palette. Shot on 35mm lens, photorealistic, cinematic lighting.
shots.end_kf: Wide angle landscape shot of the exact same framing, now featuring the concrete foundation and ground floor of a modern residential building. Midday sunlight, clear skies, sharp shadows. Industrial gray and warm sunlight. Shot on 35mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Static camera. The morning mist clears and shadows shift quickly as the empty ground morphs into the solid concrete foundation.

shots.kf: Medium shot looking up at exposed concrete pillars and steel rebar of the first floor. Overcast soft lighting, industrial brutalist aesthetic, cool gray and metallic tones. Shot on 50mm lens, photorealistic, strong geometric composition.
shots.end_kf: Medium shot of the exact same framing, now showing completed brickwork and installed glass windows on the floors. Warm late afternoon sunlight reflecting off the glass, rich terracotta and deep blue tones. Shot on 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Very slow pan right. The bare concrete structure seamlessly fills with solid bricks and reflective glass as the lighting warms up.

shots.kf: Close up of rough, unfinished exterior wall insulation, gray concrete textures and green protective mesh. Flat, diffused daylight. Muted green and gray color palette. Shot on 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic.
shots.end_kf: Close up of the exact same framing, revealing premium dark wood cladding and sleek black metal balcony railings. Sharp, contrasty sunlight casting diagonal shadows. Warm wood and dark metal palette. Shot on 85mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Extremely slow tilt up. The rough construction mesh and insulation morph smoothly into the polished premium wood and dark metal finish.

shots.kf: Wide architectural shot of the residential building under scaffolding and white protective wraps. Twilight blue hour, floodlights illuminating the site. Cool blue and harsh white lighting. Shot on 24mm lens, photorealistic, cinematic scale.
shots.end_kf: Wide architectural shot of the exact same framing, showing the fully finished, luxurious residential building. Warm interior lights glowing through the windows, twilight sky. Sleek modern architecture, premium feel. Shot on 24mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow zoom out. The scaffolding and wraps melt away to reveal the glowing, beautifully finished residential building against the evening sky.

films.line_mk: Модерно живеење во срцето на Скопје.
films.line_en: Modern living in the heart of Skopje.
films.desc_en: A fast-paced, vertical teaser designed for social media, highlighting the sleek architectural details of a new residential development.
films.music: upbeat electronic punchy bass heavy modern rhythm, 120 bpm
vo_mk: Искусете вистинска елеганција во современото живеење.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 composition. Centered massive yellow crane hook hanging against a bright blue Skopje sky. Sun flare hitting the metallic surface. High contrast, vivid yellow and deep blue palette. Shot on 50mm lens, photorealistic, sharp focus on the heavy metal.
shots.motion: Fast tilt down as the heavy crane hook lowers smoothly through the frame, sun flares shifting across the camera lens.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 composition. Centered view looking straight down into a deep foundation trench with geometric steel rebar grids. Wet, fresh dark concrete contrasting with rusty orange steel. High contrast industrial lighting. Shot on 35mm lens, photorealistic, gritty textures.
shots.motion: Slow push in on the center of the steel grid while tiny dust particles float gently in the ambient air.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 composition. Centered sleek, modern balcony with frameless glass railings and warm wooden ceiling panels. Reflected sunset light on the pristine glass. Premium, luxurious aesthetic, warm orange and deep shadow palette. Shot on 50mm lens, photorealistic, elegant.
shots.motion: Slow pan up focusing on the glass reflecting the sunset, emphasizing the premium architectural finish and peaceful evening atmosphere.

films.desc_en: A cinematic commercial following a dedicated architect as she oversees the transformation of an empty plot into a premium modern home.
films.music: Inspiring orchestral strings, warm acoustic guitar, steady build-up, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Секоја голема приказна започнува со празен простор.
Ние градиме со цврстина и посветеност.
Твојот нов дом конечно добива форма.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of a female architect in her 40s, wearing a white hard hat, navy blue blazer, and white turtleneck. She stands looking at a large empty dirt plot in Skopje, with Vodno mountain in the background. Soft morning sunlight, cinematic composition, warm earthy tones, 50mm lens.
shots.motion: The architect's hair moves gently in the breeze. A very slow, smooth camera push in towards her face.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of the female architect in her 40s (white hard hat, navy blazer, white turtleneck). She is looking down at a large rolled blueprint. The background shows blurred concrete pillars of a rising building. Crisp daylight, shallow depth of field, cool shadows, 85mm lens.
shots.motion: The architect slowly unrolls the blueprint with her hands held mostly out of frame. Subtle camera pan from left to right.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide shot of a construction site in Skopje. A large yellow crane is slowly lifting a heavy concrete panel against a clear blue sky. No people visible. Dramatic low angle, sharp focus, high contrast, industrial color palette with bright yellows and deep blues, 24mm lens.
shots.motion: The concrete panel slowly sways slightly as it is lifted upwards into the sky. Slow camera tilt up following the heavy load.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of the female architect in her 40s (white hard hat, navy blazer, white turtleneck) walking through a sunlit, raw concrete apartment structure. Large floor-to-ceiling windows reveal the Skopje cityscape. Golden hour sunlight streaming through, creating long dramatic shadows, 35mm lens.
shots.motion: The architect walks slowly forward through the space. The camera tracks backward smoothly, keeping her perfectly centered in the frame.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide shot of the female architect in her 40s (white hard hat, navy blazer, white turtleneck) standing from behind, looking up at a completed, premium modern residential building at twilight. Warm lights glow from the apartment windows. Elegant architectural design, deep blue hour sky, 24mm lens.
shots.motion: The building's exterior lights twinkle very slightly. The camera slowly cranes up to reveal the full majestic height of the finished building.

films.desc_en: An industrial and robust commercial highlighting the premium materials and expert management behind a newly constructed residential complex.
films.music: Deep electronic pulses, industrial percussion, strong steady rhythm, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Градењето бара вистинско искуство и доверба.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of a male site manager in his 50s, with a grey beard, wearing a yellow high-vis vest and an orange hard hat. He stands at a misty excavation site near the Vardar river in Skopje. Overcast morning light, gritty cinematic mood, cool blue and grey palette, 50mm lens.
shots.motion: Thick mist rolls slowly across the ground behind him. Very slow camera zoom in on the manager's determined, experienced expression.

shots.kf: Photorealistic low angle shot of the male site manager in his 50s (grey beard, yellow high-vis vest, orange hard hat) looking up at a massive steel rebar structure being assembled. The metallic grid contrasts with bright dramatic clouds. Sharp focus, strong industrial aesthetic, 35mm lens.
shots.motion: The manager slowly nods his head in approval. The camera subtly pans upwards along the massive geometric steel structure.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of thick, wet concrete being poured smoothly into a wooden formwork. Textural detail of the grey mixture settling. No people visible. Harsh midday sunlight creating deep shadows, macro photography style, highly detailed, monochromatic grey palette, 85mm lens.
shots.motion: The thick concrete slowly flows and spreads evenly across the frame. Slow, smooth camera track sliding to the right over the surface.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of the male site manager in his 50s (grey beard, yellow high-vis vest, orange hard hat) standing inside a half-finished living room, touching a freshly installed wooden window frame. Sunlight illuminates dust motes in the air. Warm afternoon light, hopeful atmosphere, 50mm lens.
shots.motion: The manager turns his head slowly to look out the window. Dust motes dance in the sunlight while the camera stays firmly locked.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide shot of the male site manager in his 50s (grey beard, yellow high-vis vest, orange hard hat) standing proudly in front of a completely finished, luxurious residential complex in Skopje. The building features lush green balconies and sleek glass. Bright sunny day, vibrant natural colors, 24mm lens.
shots.motion: The manager stands perfectly still while a gentle breeze rustles the green plants on the building's balconies. Slow camera tracking to the left.
